name: Hangler
summary:
Hangler is a short survival horror game in which you are tasked with exploring the depths of a long abandoned mine finding the emitter, a strange crystal emitting radiation that's believed to exist at the very bottom of the frozen caves.

You will of course not be alone down here, there's a species of "Hanglers" that have made their home in these tunnels, guarding the emitter. They are usually stationary unless triggered, doing so is not recommended.

Beat seeds, unlock new ways to play, and be fast.
